summary: Backend-only retest of POST /api/contact after retry hardening + Brevo authenticated domain switch (contact@leomentia-event.fr). Ran 4 pytest cases: (1) 5 consecutive submits all return 200 with email_sent=true AND client_email_sent=true, (2) all 5 leads persisted in Mongo via GET /api/contacts, (3) invalid email -> 422, (4) log inspection confirms retry mechanism works. All 4 tests PASS (4/4). During my run, all 10 emails (5 admin + 5 client) succeeded on attempt 1 — no 401 transient this time. Historical log evidence shows earlier submissions: 4 transient 'Brevo attempt 1 failed (401) unrecognised IP' were each followed by 'sent ... on attempt 2' — retry absorbs Brevo IP-propagation flakiness as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: send_brevo_email: retry loop (3 attempts, 1.2s sleep) correctly re-tries on any non-2xx AND on exceptions. Handles both transient 401 and network errors.
Lead persisted BEFORE email send — no data loss even if all 3 retries fail.
email_sent / client_email_sent flags exposed on response for observability.
GET /api/contacts uses {'_id': 0} projection — no ObjectId issue.
Sender is now the authenticated domain contact@leomentia-event.fr — SPF/DKIM aligned, deliverability improved.
Nit (non-blocking): httpx.AsyncClient is created inside the retry loop per attempt; could hoist for micro-perf, but total time is negligible (<5s max).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_contact_brevo_retry.py. Env: source REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env before running. Log tail on 22 Sep shows retry recovery pattern working (attempt 1 -> 401 -> attempt 2 -> sent). Owner has disabled Brevo IP allowlist + validated domain leomentia-event.fr; current runs succeed on attempt 1 directly.
rca of the issue: Root cause was external: Brevo 'Authorised IPs' setting rejected the container's dynamic egress IP with HTTP 401 'unrecognised IP address'. Client disabled the restriction and authenticated the domain leomentia-event.fr; sender was switched to contact@leomentia-event.fr. Code hardening: send_brevo_email now retries up to 3x with 1.2s backoff to absorb any transient 401 during Brevo IP/config propagation. Verified with 5 consecutive submits — 100% success rate on both admin and client emails.
